Subject: Milestone PO structure + VAT reverse-charge question

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Saffron's PM and finance teams liked the model for milestone billing. Before we start onboarding, procurement asked for a clear PO format we can send to AP so invoices map to milestones correctly. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you confirm the exact PO line-item format Redwood needs to tie an invoice to a milestone (fields we need on the PO: PO number, line item ID, milestone code, deliverable description, amount, currency, start/end dates, invoice URN)?
2) We're EU-registered and may need to use reverse-charge for some line items. Do you need an attestation document from our tax team to apply reverse-charge on Redwood invoices, or will a VAT ID + EORI suffice?

Attaching our internal procurement template for reference. If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min sync with finance.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Procurement
Saffron Therapeutics

From: rachel_kim@redwood.com
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@saffron.co>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Milestone PO structure + VAT reverse-charge question

Hi Maya — great to hear the demo landed well. Short answers up front and a checklist below.

1) PO line-item requirements: Redwood needs PO number + one PO line per milestone. For each line we expect: PO number, PO line ID, milestone code (e.g., M1, M2), deliverable short description (max 80 chars), currency, net amount, invoice URN (optional but preferred), and scheduled milestone date. If you can include "invoice to milestone mapping" in the PO comments we can auto-link in our AP ingestion pipeline.

2) VAT reverse-charge: For EU customers applying reverse-charge, we require both the customer VAT ID and a signed reverse-charge attestation on company letterhead (simple one-page statement) referencing the specific PO(s). The VAT ID alone is not sufficient for our tax team to mark invoices as reverse-charge.

Checklist I'm attaching: - AP_Onboarding_Packet_Saffron.pdf (contains vendor registration fields + bank routing requirements) - Saffron_Milestone_PO_2026-11.csv (example PO with two milestone lines) - VAT_Reverse_Charge_Attestation_Saffron.docx (template for your tax team)

Quick notes:
- Partial draws / milestone partial invoicing is supported; include the milestone code and partial percentage on the invoice.
- We need the legal entity name to match vendor registration exactly for payments and tax reporting.
- Preferred invoice URN format: REDWOOD-DF8721-<YYYYMMDD>-INVnnn

If useful, Ben (cc'd) can confirm bank and TIN verification steps. Happy to jump on a call tomorrow morning UK time.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: AP_Onboarding_Packet_Saffron.pdf, Saffron_Milestone_PO_2026-11.csv, VAT_Reverse_Charge_Attestation_Saffron.docx

Looping in a few compliance points from finance:

- We must validate the customer VAT ID against EU VIES and keep a copy of the reverse-charge attestation on file for audit (3 years). Please request the attestation to include the PO numbers it covers.
- For payouts, our payment system requires the vendor remit legal name exact match and the vendor record to include a bank IBAN + SWIFT for EUR payments. If Saffron will take local transfers in the UK/SEPA, provide the EORI when applicable.
- If Saffron expects split payments across legal entities, confirm which entity will be invoiced for each milestone — that needs separate vendor profiles.

Rachel — can you ask them to return: signed attestation, the PO CSV with PO line IDs filled, and vendor bank profile? Once we have those, finance can approve initial invoice processing in 3-5 business days.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Finance Operations (AP)
Redwood Inference

Thanks — received everything, looks good. Final implementation notes and next steps:

1) Vendor registration: please complete the AP_Onboarding_Packet and return via the Hub link (https://redwood.app/drive/collection/DF-8721-onboarding). We need separate vendor profiles for each legal entity (Therapeutics Ltd and R&D BV).
2) Invoicing: Redwood cannot accept a single invoice that intermixes remit instructions for two tax entities. Please submit separate invoices per legal entity (one invoice per entity per milestone). Each invoice should include the PO number + PO line ID and the milestone code.
3) Reverse-charge: attestation received and filed — our tax team will apply reverse-charge to invoices for which the attestation references the exact PO numbers. We will notify you in the invoice acknowledgement email if any documentation is missing.
4) Timeline: once vendor profiles are created and documents are uploaded, finance will enable invoice processing for the first milestone within 3 business days. Payments follow our standard net-30 unless otherwise agreed in the SOW (DocuSign: 0x7a9b-saffron-sow).

If you'd like, we can arrange a 20-minute handoff with our AP intake specialist (Marissa) to validate the file formats before you submit the first invoice.

Best,
Rachel Kim
